**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 74 **Price** 320 gp **Ammunition** ballista bolt (5 sp, 1 Bulk) --- **Usage** mounted **Space** 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 4 feet tall **Crew** 2 **Proficiency** martial --- **AC** 17 **Fort** +12 **Ref** +11 **Hardness** 10 **HP** 40 **Immunities** object immunities --- **Speed** 20 feet (pulled or pushed) --- Resembling a massive crossbow mounted on a tripod, but with a pair of arms for torsion instead of a single prod, a ballista flings massive bolts. Also referred to as a scorpion, this weapon requires fewer crew members than the larger heavy ballista and can be Aimed and Loaded much more quickly.
**Aim** 35 feet, minimum distance 25 feet
**Load** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) 2 times
**Launch** ([attack](/Traits.aspx?ID=15), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104), [range increment 120](/Traits.aspx?ID=248) feet) 4d12 piercing, single target, DC 19 Reflex
